<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="content" string="true">from geom.vec import Vec

__all__ = ["Vec", "area", "centroid"]


def area(points):
    """Shoelace area of a polygon given as Vecs."""
    s = 0.0
    for a, b in zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]):
        s += a.x * b.y - b.x * a.y
    return abs(s) / 2


def centroid(points):
    n = len(points)
    return Vec(sum(p.x for p in points) / n, sum(p.y for p in points) / n)
